metadata.description: Data engineering agent that creates, extends, and explores dlt data pipelines

plugins.name: rest-api-pipeline
plugins.description: REST API data pipelines with dlt (data load tool). Find sources, scaffold pipelines, debug, validate data, add endpoints, configure incremental loading, query data, and create interactive reports.

plugins.name: bootstrap
plugins.description: Prepare Python environment for dlthub workspace

plugins.name: data-exploration
plugins.description: Quick insights from dlt pipeline data. Connect to a pipeline, profile tables, plan charts, and assemble marimo dashboards.

plugins.name: dlthub-platform
plugins.description: Deploy dlthub workspace and pipelines to the dltHub platform

plugins.name: init
plugins.description: Shared rules, secrets handling, and workspace MCP for dlthub

plugins.name: transformations
plugins.description: Transform raw dlt pipeline data into a Canonical Data Model. Annotate sources, build an ontology, design a CDM with Kimball dimensional modeling, and write @dlt.hub.transformation functions.

plugins.name: sql-database-pipeline
plugins.description: Build SQL database pipelines with dlt: connect to any SQLAlchemy-supported database, load tables to a destination, tune performance with backends.

plugins.name: data-quality
plugins.description: Add checks and metrics to dlt pipelines — inspect schema for candidates, define column-level validations and load metrics, run them on every pipeline load, and review results with failure diagnosis.

plugins.name: filesystem-pipeline
plugins.description: Load files (CSV, Parquet, JSONL, or custom) from local disk, S3, GCS, Azure, or SFTP into a destination using dlt's filesystem source.

plugins.name: quick-start
plugins.description: Full-path guided start: ingest → visualize → transform → deploy in 3-5 prompts. Routes to the right entry skill based on a chosen depth.

plugins.name: one-shot
plugins.description: Build and run a minimal REST API pipeline for GitHub, then deploy it to dltHub Platform.

plugins.name: dlthub-init-skills
plugins.description: Build and deploy a minimal custom REST API pipeline to dltHub Platform after uvx dlthub-init setup
